sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，所有人都可以免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》App 进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today, a special episode from my colleagues, Andy Mills and Bianca Gaver.
sentences.zh: 今天是一期来自我的同事安迪·米尔斯和比安卡·加弗的特别节目。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月21日，星期一。

sentences.en: The year 2020 was difficult, painful at times, and I spent much of the past year essentially on the America is divided beat.
sentences.zh: 2020年是艰难的一年，有时甚至痛苦，过去一年我大部分时间都在跑“美国正处于分裂中”这条线。

sentences.en: I traveled through dozens of states, attended a bunch of political rallies, talked to voters who lived in increasingly different realities,
sentences.zh: 我走访了数十个州，参加了一堆政治集会，与那些生活在日益割裂的现实中的选民交谈，

sentences.en: and because of the coronavirus, instead of flying around from place to place, I found myself, for the first time in over a decade, back driving a car.
sentences.zh: 而因为冠状病毒，我不再飞来飞去，十多年来第一次重新开始自己开车。

sentences.en: And as I drove for hundreds and thousands of miles, I listened to the radio.
sentences.zh: 在我驱车行驶了成千上万英里的过程中，我听着广播。

sentences.en: And I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I loved getting to know all the new pop songs.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢了解所有这些新的流行歌曲。

sentences.en: I loved finally figuring out why it is everybody likes this Harry Styles guy.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢终于弄清楚为什么每个人都喜欢这个叫哈里·斯泰尔斯的家伙。

sentences.en: And it was there, in the car one night.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，在一个夜晚的车里。

sentences.en: I was scanning through the stations, and I rediscovered Delilah.
sentences.zh: 我扫着电台频道，重新发现了黛莉拉。

sentences.en: I'm Delilah.
sentences.zh: 我是黛莉拉。

sentences.en: Hi, Delilah.
sentences.zh: 嗨，黛莉拉。

sentences.en: Thank you for such a great show every night.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你每天晚上带来这么棒的节目。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for being so patient.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么有耐心。

sentences.en: What can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 我能为你做些什么？

sentences.en: I would just like to know if you have Kenny Rogers through the years who could play for me.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道你有没有肯尼·罗杰斯的《历经岁月》，能为我放一下吗。

sentences.en: Oh, I love that song.
sentences.zh: 噢，我喜欢那首歌。

sentences.en: I do, too.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢。

sentences.en: Is it a dedication or just a favorite?
sentences.zh: 这是一个特别献礼还是单纯的最爱？

sentences.en: No, my husband passed away for the year that came out, in 82.
sentences.zh: 不，我丈夫在那首歌发行的那一年，也就是82年去世了。

sentences.en: And it was everything our life was for 31 years of marriage, a good marriage.
sentences.zh: 那是我们31年婚姻生活中的全部，一段美好的婚姻。

sentences.en: And he died much too young.
sentences.zh: 他走得太早了。

sentences.en: So if you could find it in your records there, I would appreciate your playing it for me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能在你的唱片里找到它，我将感激你为我播放它。

sentences.en: And what's your late husband's name, Helen?
sentences.zh: 你已故的丈夫叫什么名字，海伦？

sentences.en: Jack.
sentences.zh: 杰克。

sentences.en: I can't remember when you weren't there
sentences.zh: 我记不清什么时候你不在身边

sentences.en: When I didn't care And hearing her show again, there in my car, I felt emotional.
sentences.zh: 当我并不在意的时候。再次在车里听到她的节目，我百感交集。

sentences.en: I started doing this, like, laugh-cry thing that I do sometimes whenever I get, like, overwhelmed by emotions that are confusing but powerful.
sentences.zh: 我开始做那种“又哭又笑”的表情，每当我被那些令人困惑却又强烈的海量情绪压垮时，我有时就会这样。

sentences.en: And I was like, why is this hitting me so hard right now?
sentences.zh: 我在想，为什么这会在此时此刻对我产生这么大的冲击？

sentences.en: And at first I assumed, like, obviously some of this is just nostalgia.
sentences.zh: 起初我以为，显然其中一部分只是恋旧。

sentences.en: We are here to put a smile on your face as we share great music.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里分享美妙的音乐，只为博你一笑。

sentences.en: I had originally become a fan of Delilah's radio show back when I was just in junior high.
sentences.zh: 我最初成为黛莉拉广播节目的粉丝还是在我上初中的时候。

sentences.en: I'm Delilah on the new 94.1, The Sound.
sentences.zh: 我是新94.1电台“之音”的黛莉拉。

sentences.en: At the time, I was too small for my age.
sentences.zh: 当时，我的个子比同龄人矮小。

sentences.en: I wasn't getting along with my parents, who weren't getting along with each other.
sentences.zh: 我和父母相处得不好，他们彼此也合不来。

sentences.en: I was grounded all the time.
sentences.zh: 我总被罚禁足。

sentences.en: I was living in this small town, and I wanted nothing more than to grow up.
sentences.zh: 我住在那个小镇里，最大的愿望就是快点长大。

sentences.en: To get out of that small town, fall in love, and become an adult.
sentences.zh: 离开那个小镇，坠入爱河，成为一个成年人。

sentences.en: And listening to this show up in my room, in my headphones, it was like my first real peek into the lives of grown-ups.
sentences.zh: 在我的房间里、戴着耳机听着这个节目，就像是我对成年人生活真正意义上的第一次窥探。

sentences.en: Melanie, what can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 梅兰妮，我能为你做些什么？

sentences.en: Actually, I was wondering if you could possibly request a song for me and my husband.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在想你是否能为我和我丈夫点一首歌。

sentences.en: We've been married for the past three years, and we've just gone through a lot, a lot of problems, almost on the verge of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我们结婚三年了，刚刚经历了许多、许多的问题，几乎到了最糟糕的边缘。

sentences.en: I was a practicing alcoholic for quite so many years, and recently that has changed.
sentences.zh: 我曾经是一个多年的瘾君子，最近情况变了。

sentences.en: Practicing, or did you have it perfected?
sentences.zh: 习惯成自然，还是你已经炉火纯青了？

sentences.en: Oh, I had it more than perfected.
sentences.zh: 噢，我何止是炉火纯青。

sentences.en: I was a true professional.
sentences.zh: 我简直是个专业人士。

sentences.en: And what has happened over the last year is that a woman that I loved very much, and still do very much, has come back into my life, and that's the mother of my daughter.
sentences.zh: 过去一年发生的事情是，一个我深爱、现在依然深爱着的女人回到了我的生活中，她是我女儿的母亲。

sentences.en: What Delilah was doing was simple.
sentences.zh: 黛莉拉所做的事情很简单。

sentences.en: She was taking calls from all sorts of people from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 她接听来自全国各地各种各样人们的电话。

sentences.en: I drive a truck, and I'm on the road all the time.
sentences.zh: 我是一名卡车司机，总是在路上跑。

sentences.en: And I spend a lot of time away from my wife and my kids.
sentences.zh: 我有很多时间不在妻子和孩子身边。

sentences.en: Listening to them.
sentences.zh: 听着他们的心声。

sentences.en: I'm going through a divorce, and I have two young children.
sentences.zh: 我正在经历离婚，我有两个年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: And it's been quite difficult, and I sometimes feel that there's nobody out there for me.
sentences.zh: 这相当艰难，我有时觉得身边没有人能依靠。

sentences.en: And whatever it was they were calling to say.
sentences.zh: 无论他们打电话来是为了说什么。

sentences.en: What can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 我能为你做些什么？

sentences.en: I'd like to know if you can dedicate a song to my wife.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能否为我妻子点一首歌。

sentences.en: What's her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Her name is Margaret.
sentences.zh: 她叫玛格丽特。

sentences.en: I goofed up, and I'm very sorry.
sentences.zh: 我搞砸了，我非常抱歉。

sentences.en: What'd you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: I lied to her.
sentences.zh: 我向她撒了谎。

sentences.en: About?
sentences.zh: 关于什么的？

sentences.en: I got hurt on the job.
sentences.zh: 我在工作时受了伤。

sentences.en: I got addicted to drugs, and I lied to her.
sentences.zh: 我对药物上瘾了，我向她隐瞒了这件事。

sentences.en: And I'm very sorry.
sentences.zh: 我非常抱歉。

sentences.en: Are you going to go get help for your addiction?
sentences.zh: 你打算为你的瘾头去寻求帮助吗？

sentences.en: I already am.
sentences.zh: 我已经开始了。

sentences.en: Good for you.
sentences.zh: 真为你高兴。

sentences.en: Do you think she might have a forgiving heart and see you through this?
sentences.zh: 你认为她会有一颗宽容的心，陪你度过难关吗？

sentences.en: I'm hoping.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: Right now, I'm not at the house.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不在家里。

sentences.en: And I'm begging for her forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 我在祈求她的原谅。

sentences.en: Well, let's hope then that she...
sentences.zh: 好吧，那让我们希望她……

sentences.en: And then at the end of the call, she would pick out a pop song for them.
sentences.zh: 然后在通话结束时，她会为他们挑选一首流行歌曲。

sentences.en: Let me find a song for you.
sentences.zh: 让我为你找首歌。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: 多谢了。

sentences.en: That was in some way connected to their situation.
sentences.zh: 这首歌在某种程度上与他们的处境有关。

sentences.en: And this combination of being confessional and then together sitting and listening to pop music
sentences.zh: 这种既有倾诉剖白，又有一同坐下来听流行音乐的结合，

sentences.en: and just being awash in the mysterious power that pop music has to make people feel.
sentences.zh: 完全沉浸在流行音乐触动人心的神秘力量中。

sentences.en: For all those times you stood by me, for all the trees...
sentences.zh: 为了你曾经支持我的那些时光，为了所有的树木……

sentences.en: I had loved it as a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候很喜欢它。

sentences.en: But hearing it right now, as an adult, it seemed more powerful somehow.
sentences.zh: 但现在作为一个成年人听到它，不知为何显得更有力量。

sentences.en: And I didn't know why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: And so I decided to reach out to a bunch of my friends, ask them to listen to Delilah, and essentially let me know if it hit them the way it hit me.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定联系我的一群朋友，让他们听听黛莉拉的节目，并基本上告诉我，这是否像冲击我那样冲击了他们。

sentences.en: I know we've been dealing with the new reality, the COVID-19 reality, a long time.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们一直在应对新现实，也就是 COVID-19 的现实，已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: And even though there's a lot of negative in the pandemic, a lot of sadness, there are some things that are good.
sentences.zh: 尽管这场大流行中有很多负面因素、有很多悲伤，但也有一些好的事情。

sentences.en: I'll be sharing words of love and hope and inspiration and, of course, fabulous songs all day long.
sentences.zh: 我一整天都会分享爱、希望和鼓舞的话语，当然，还有美妙的歌曲。

sentences.en: So one day, I'm sitting in my apartment, and I hear from my friend Andy.
sentences.zh: 所以有一天，我坐在公寓里，收到了我朋友安迪的消息。

sentences.en: And he asks me to listen to this lady on the radio called Delilah.
sentences.zh: 他让我听听广播里这个叫黛莉拉的女士。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I know Delilah.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，我知道黛莉拉。

sentences.en: She got her start in Seattle, where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 她是从我成长的西雅图发迹的。

sentences.en: And I'd hear her all the time on the radio.
sentences.zh: 我经常在收音机里听到她。

sentences.en: But my association with the show was basically just that super cheesy intro.
sentences.zh: 但我对这个节目的印象基本上仅限于那个超级俗气的开场白。

sentences.en: And that she played pop music, which I don't really listen to.
sentences.zh: 还有她播放我其实并不怎么听的流行音乐。

sentences.en: When Andy called me months into the pandemic, I was deep in a sad folk music phase.
sentences.zh: 当安迪在大流行几个月后打电话给我时，我正深陷于悲伤的民谣音乐阶段。

sentences.en: I was spending a lot of time alone.
sentences.zh: 我大部分时间都在独处。

sentences.en: I was single for the first time in a while.
sentences.zh: 我一段时间以来第一次单身。

sentences.en: I missed my friends.
sentences.zh: 我想念我的朋友们。

sentences.en: I even missed strangers.
sentences.zh: 我甚至想念陌生人。

sentences.en: So one night in quarantine, I turned on Delilah.
sentences.zh: 所以在隔离的一个晚上，我打开了黛莉拉的节目。

sentences.en: Hi, good evening.
sentences.zh: 嗨，晚上好。

sentences.en: Is this Bob?
sentences.zh: 这是鲍勃吗？

sentences.en: This is Bob.
sentences.zh: 我是鲍勃。

sentences.en: Hi, Bob.
sentences.zh: 嗨，鲍勃。

sentences.en: What can I do to make your night a little better just for you?
sentences.zh: 我能做点什么让你的夜晚变得更好一点呢？

sentences.en: I just want to tell you about the most incredible lady I have ever met.
sentences.zh: 我只想跟你讲讲我见过的最不可思议的女士。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What's her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Her name is BJ.
sentences.zh: 她叫 BJ。

sentences.en: Now, are you guys dating?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们在约会吗？

sentences.en: Are you together?
sentences.zh: 你们在一起吗？

sentences.en: Are you a couple?
sentences.zh: 你们是一对吗？

sentences.en: I was an idiot.
sentences.zh: 我以前是个白痴。

sentences.en: I let her walk out of my life about seven, eight years ago.
sentences.zh: 大约七、八年前，我让她走出了我的生活。

sentences.en: Oh, Bob.
sentences.zh: 噢，鲍勃。

sentences.en: What were you thinking?
sentences.zh: 你在想什么呢？

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, I was taken by the callers.
sentences.zh: 很快，我就被这些来电者吸引了。

sentences.en: You knucklehead you.
sentences.zh: 你这个笨蛋。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: A thousand percent.
sentences.zh: 一千个同意。

sentences.en: What we have to do here is, number one, hope she may, by some stretch of the imagination, be listening.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要做的第一件事，是希望她可能出于某种想象不到的原因正在收听。

sentences.en: She probably is.
sentences.zh: 她可能正在听。

sentences.en: Well, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的。

sentences.en: At first, it was a voyeuristic pleasure.
sentences.zh: 起初，这是一种窥视癖带来的快感。

sentences.en: Like, almost a little schadenfreude.
sentences.zh: 就像是带有一点幸灾乐祸。

sentences.en: When you're single, it's kind of nice to hear that not everyone's relationships are going great.
sentences.zh: 当你单身时，听到并非每个人的感情都一帆风顺，感觉还挺不错的。

sentences.en: But after a while, how are you?
sentences.zh: 但过了一会儿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm kind of in a melancholy mode tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚有点忧郁。

sentences.en: I broke the trust of the woman that I love, and I'm doing everything I can to try to get it back again.
sentences.zh: 我辜负了我所深爱的女人的信任，我正在尽我所能试图重新赢回它。

sentences.en: The vulnerability of the callers.
sentences.zh: 来电者们的脆弱。

sentences.en: I love her a whole lot, Delilah.
sentences.zh: 我非常爱她，黛莉拉。

sentences.en: Got to me.
sentences.zh: 触动了我。

sentences.en: You know, it's just been really tough, really tough.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这真的很艰难，非常艰难。

sentences.en: We've been up and down like a roller coaster, and trying to get it together has just been, you know, the toughest of all.
sentences.zh: 我们的感情就像过山车一样起起伏伏，想要把它重归于好真的是，你知道的，最难的事情。

sentences.en: And we listen to your show every night, and you're so compassionate, and we wanted to call you.
sentences.zh: 我们每天晚上都听你的节目，你那么富有同情心，我们想给你打电话。

sentences.en: And within the context of these calls, the song started to get to me, too.
sentences.zh: 在这些电话的语境下，这些歌也开始触动我了。

sentences.en: So then I looked her up, and I found out that she is the most listened-to woman on American radio.
sentences.zh: 所以后来我查了一下，发现她是美国电台里收听率最高的女主播。

sentences.en: Like, when you look at the list of the top 20 radio shows, there's NPR, there's Conservative
sentences.zh: 你看前20大广播节目的榜单时，有NPR（美国国家公共电台），有保守派

sentences.en: Talk Radio, and Delilah.
sentences.zh: 脱口秀电台，还有德莱拉（Delilah）。

sentences.en: So many folks angry with one another, arguing, up in each other's faces, saying unkind things.
sentences.zh: 有那么多人在互相生气、争论、针锋相对，说一些尖酸刻薄的话。

sentences.en: Choose your words carefully.
sentences.zh: 谨言慎行。

sentences.en: And make sure your words are seasoned with love.
sentences.zh: 确保你的言语充满爱意。

sentences.en: And unlike other shows, Delilah's audience can't be categorized.
sentences.zh: 与其他节目不同，德莱拉的听众无法被归类。

sentences.en: It's people from red states and blue states, a mix of ages, backgrounds, race, and ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 他们来自红州和蓝州，涵盖各种年龄、背景、种族和族裔。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你听得到我吗？

sentences.en: Can you hear me now?
sentences.zh: 你现在听得到我吗？

sentences.en: And so, hoping to better understand what it was that she had tapped into, Bianca and I did what millions of Americans before us have done.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了更好地理解她究竟触动了什么，我和比安卡（Bianca）做了无数美国人之前做过的事。

sentences.en: Hello!
sentences.zh: 喂！

sentences.en: Hi!
sentences.zh: 嗨！

sentences.en: Who am I talking to?
sentences.zh: 我在和谁说话？

sentences.en: We called Delilah.
sentences.zh: 我们给德莱拉打了个电话。

sentences.en: I'm Bianca.
sentences.zh: 我是比安卡。

sentences.en: And I'm Andy.
sentences.zh: 我是安迪。

sentences.en: Hi, Bianca.
sentences.zh: 嗨，比安卡。

sentences.en: Hi, Andy.
sentences.zh: 嗨，安迪。

sentences.en: So, are you recording on your end, Delilah?
sentences.zh: 那么，德莱拉，你那边在录音吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it looks great on mine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我这边看起来很棒。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每天都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成

sentences.en: like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 一个充满50年历史精美艺术品的生动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订购《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间去突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I grew up on the Southern Oregon coaSt.
sentences.zh: 我在俄勒冈州南部海岸长大。

sentences.en: We started at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们从头说起。

sentences.en: My parents were caretakers.
sentences.zh: 我的父母是看管人。

sentences.en: They rented an old farmhouse, and they could work off the rent by milking cows.
sentences.zh: 他们租了一栋老农舍，可以通过挤牛奶来抵房租。

sentences.en: It was a little dairy farm.
sentences.zh: 那是一个小型奶牛场。

sentences.en: She grew up in the 60s and 70s in the small town of Reedsport, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 她在60和70年代在俄勒冈州的小镇里德斯波特（Reedsport）长大。

sentences.en: Everybody went fishing together and crabbing together, and everybody knew when Mrs. Luke,
sentences.zh: 大家一起去钓鱼，一起去捉螃蟹，每个人都知道当露克太太——

sentences.en: my mom had the hair clippers out because she would cut everybody's hair in the neighborhood for free.
sentences.zh: 也就是我妈妈拿出理发推子的时候，因为她会免费为附近的所有人理发。

sentences.en: And from her earliest memories, I sadly had the show-off gene and not a lick of talent.
sentences.zh: 从她最早的记忆开始，我悲哀地拥有炫耀的基因，却一点才华也没有。

sentences.en: She loved attention.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢引人注目。

sentences.en: But she says she wasn't getting the kind of attention she wanted.
sentences.zh: 但她说她没有得到她想要的关注。

sentences.en: I wasn't an attractive child.
sentences.zh: 我不是一个漂亮的孩子。

sentences.en: I was a goofy, clumsy, chubby little girl with steel braces on my legs.
sentences.zh: 我是一个傻乎乎、笨拙、胖乎乎的小女孩，腿上戴着钢制支架。

sentences.en: If you ever saw Forrest Gump, I actually wore the braces for 10 years that he wore in that movie and never felt graceful or beautiful.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过《阿甘正传》，我其实戴了他在那部电影里戴了10年的支架，从来没觉得自己优雅或美丽。

sentences.en: And then puberty came knocking.
sentences.zh: 然后青春期敲门了。

sentences.en: And wow, what a change.
sentences.zh: 哇，真是个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: So I left junior high this, you know, zit-faced, goofy, chubby girl, and I started high school looking like I was 19 years old.
sentences.zh: 所以，我离开初中时还是个长满青春痘、傻乎乎、胖乎乎的女孩，而我开始上高中时看起来就像19岁一样。

sentences.en: And I think I would have gotten into a lot of trouble if it weren't for the fact that I could channel my energies into radio.
sentences.zh: 我想我要不是能把精力倾注在广播上，肯定会惹上很多麻烦。

sentences.en: Luckily, it was right then that she got a job at KDUN, the AM radio station in her hometown.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，就在那时，她在她家乡的AM广播电台KDUN找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: I had to be there at 5, 5.30 in the morning to go on the air at 6.
sentences.zh: 我必须在早上5点、5点半到那儿，以便在6点钟上台直播。

sentences.en: And so there was no going out on Friday or Saturday nights.
sentences.zh: 所以星期五或星期六晚上没有出去玩这回事。

sentences.en: There was no going to parties.
sentences.zh: 没有去参加派对这回事。

sentences.en: There was no going and doing any of the things that all the kids in the 70s did.
sentences.zh: 没有去做70年代所有孩子们做的任何事情这回事。

sentences.en: Because I had to have my butt up and in the station at 5 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 因为我必须在早上5点钟起床并坐在电台里。

sentences.en: Elton John had hit the scene really big right when I started in radio.
sentences.zh: 就在我开始做广播的时候，埃尔顿·约翰（Elton John）在乐坛大红大紫。

sentences.en: We played Jim Croce.
sentences.zh: 我们播放吉姆·克罗切（Jim Croce）的歌。

sentences.en: E-T-O-Bachman-Turner Overdrive was my favorite.
sentences.zh: 巴赫曼-特纳超速乐团（Bachman-Turner Overdrive）是我的最爱。

sentences.en: And what was it that you liked about it?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢它什么呢？

sentences.en: Talk about being heaven for somebody with the show-off gene.
sentences.zh: 对于有炫耀基因的人来说，这简直就是天堂。

sentences.en: I could go on the air and say, hey, if you're driving down 101, honk.
sentences.zh: 我可以上台说，嘿，如果你正开着车沿着101国道行驶，按一下喇叭。

sentences.en: And, you know, 15 people would drive by and honk.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，会有15个人开车经过并按喇叭。

sentences.en: I was like, that is the coolest sensation in the world!
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，那是世界上最酷的感觉！

sentences.en: So, yeah, it fulfilled so many needs in me.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它满足了我内心的许多需求。

sentences.en: Listening to her tell this story,
sentences.zh: 听着她讲这个故事，

sentences.en: I was sort of amazed to hear that this woman who seemed to have spoken directly into the ear of this lonely kid up in his bedroom had herself also been a lonely kid.
sentences.zh: 我有点惊讶地听到，这个似乎曾直接在卧室里对那个孤独小孩的耳朵说话的女人，她自己也曾是个孤独的小孩。

sentences.en: You know, my mom had issues.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我妈妈有心事。

sentences.en: My dad had issues.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸有心事。

sentences.en: I found out that my father had actually been married before my mother and had two children that lived half an hour away.
sentences.zh: 我发现我父亲在和我母亲结婚之前其实结过婚，有两个孩子住在半小时车程外。

sentences.en: And we never knew about them.
sentences.zh: 而我们从不知道他们的存在。

sentences.en: It was this big, deep, dark secret.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的、深不可测的秘密。

sentences.en: And they dealt with their issues by kind of shutting down emotionally.
sentences.zh: 他们通过情感封闭来应对自己的心事。

sentences.en: And the radio station was just like my sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 而广播电台就像是我的避难所。

sentences.en: It was a safe place.
sentences.zh: 那是一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: The people there loved me and encouraged me.
sentences.zh: 那里的人们爱我、鼓励我。

sentences.en: They were rock-solid people in my life.
sentences.zh: 他们是我生命中坚如磐石的人。

sentences.en: And so, after she graduated, she wanted to move away from her small town, but she wanted to stay in the world of radio.
sentences.zh: 因此，她毕业后，想离开自己的小镇，但她想留在广播界。

sentences.en: And eventually, she landed a job working the late shift as a DJ at a soft rock radio station in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 最终，她在西雅图的一家轻摇滚广播电台找到了一份晚班DJ的工作。

sentences.en: Called Classy.
sentences.zh: 电台名叫Classy。

sentences.en: It was 1984, and it sounded like Elton John's softer side, you know, tiny dancer, Billy Joel.
sentences.zh: 那是1984年，听起来像是埃尔顿·约翰比较柔和的一面，你知道的，比如《小舞者》（Tiny Dancer）、比利·乔尔（Billy Joel）。

sentences.en: She can kill with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她能用微笑杀人。

sentences.en: She can wound with her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她能用眼神中伤。

sentences.en: And she said that a lot of nights, she'd get these calls from people wanting to hear a certain song.
sentences.zh: 她说很多天晚上，她都会接到这些电话，人们想听某首歌。

sentences.en: And that off the air, while the music played, she'd talk with them.
sentences.zh: 在节目之外，当音乐播放时，她会和他们聊天。

sentences.en: And these conversations gave her an idea for her own show.
sentences.zh: 这些对话为她自己的节目提供了一个灵感。

sentences.en: And she pitched it to her boss.
sentences.zh: 她向她的老板提出了这个想法。

sentences.en: I said, people call me and tell me the most fascinating stories.
sentences.zh: 我说，人们打电话给我，告诉我最迷人的故事。

sentences.en: This is really amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真的很了不起。

sentences.en: Can I put it on the air?
sentences.zh: 我能把它播出来吗？

sentences.en: And her boss was like, sure.
sentences.zh: 她的老板说，当然。

sentences.en: Sounds fine.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: And so, this was the beginning of Delilah starting to find her own signature sound.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是德莱拉开始寻找自己标志性声音的开始。

sentences.en: What did that sound like?
sentences.zh: 那声音听起来是怎样的？

sentences.en: The mood was more mellow.
sentences.zh: 情绪更加柔和。

sentences.en: I was trying to put people to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我当时在试图让人们入睡。

sentences.en: If you have to be out tonight driving, drive carefully.
sentences.zh: 如果你今晚必须开车外出，请小心驾驶。

sentences.en: It's wet and windy and cold.
sentences.zh: 又湿又风大又冷。

sentences.en: More of the same expected throughout the day tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 预计明天一整天都是如此。

sentences.en: There was more sound effects I used.
sentences.zh: 我使用了更多音效。

sentences.en: Gliss, it was called, where it sounds like wind chimes.
sentences.zh: 这被称为Gliss，听起来就像风铃。

sentences.en: Used a lot of seagulls and crashing waves.
sentences.zh: 用了大量海鸥声和海浪拍打声。

sentences.en: For Lisa and Kevin, congratulations, you two.
sentences.zh: 致丽莎（Lisa）和凯文（Kevin），恭喜你们俩。

sentences.en: People called mostly when they were falling in love.
sentences.zh: 人们打电话来的时候大多正在恋爱。

sentences.en: A lot of relationships just beginning, just budding.
sentences.zh: 许多恋情刚刚开始，刚刚萌芽。

sentences.en: I had tons of teenagers calling in.
sentences.zh: 我有大量的青少年打电话进来。

sentences.en: Well, I wanted to dedicate a song to my best friend and a guy she likes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想把一首歌献给我最好的朋友和她喜欢的一个男生。

sentences.en: Who?
sentences.zh: 谁？

sentences.en: A guy named Joey in our class.
sentences.zh: 我们班一个叫乔伊（Joey）的男生。

sentences.en: But she was also hearing from older listeners with more adult love stories.
sentences.zh: 但她也听到了年长听众的声音，他们的爱情故事更具成年人的色彩。

sentences.en: When you say ex-husband, I don't feel like you want it to be ex anymore.
sentences.zh: 当你说前夫时，我觉得你已经不想让他再当你的前夫了。

sentences.en: He's my best friend and he's really a very special man.
sentences.zh: 他是我的最好朋友，而且他确实是一个非常特别的男人。

sentences.en: So if you knew then what you know now, would he be your ex-husband?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你早知今日，还会让他成为你的前夫吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 可能不会。

sentences.en: But it's too late now.
sentences.zh: 但现在为时已晚。

sentences.en: But we've made the best of the situation and we'll always be part of each other's lives.
sentences.zh: 不过我们已经把目前的处境做到了最好，并且我们永远是彼此生命的一部分。

sentences.en: I will certainly get that on the air for you, Terry.
sentences.zh: 我一定会把那首歌为你播出的，特里（Terry）。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And the show went from number 17 or 18 to number one in the market.
sentences.zh: 节目从该市场的第17或第18名跃升至第一名。

sentences.en: It struck a chord in a lot of hearts and I grew a very strong and faithful audience quickly.
sentences.zh: 它触动了许多人的心弦，我迅速培养了一批非常强大且忠实的听众。

sentences.en: But from early on, Delilah wanted a bigger audience beyond the city.
sentences.zh: 但从早期开始，德莱拉就想要超越这个城市，拥有更大的受众。

sentences.en: And she started pitching the show around for syndication.
sentences.zh: 她开始到处推销这个节目以进行全美联播。

sentences.en: And at each station, the bosses would say, ah, yeah, it's not going to work.
sentences.zh: 在每个电台，老板们都会说，啊，行吧，这行不通。

sentences.en: I mean, you're number one in Seattle, but that's because you're Seattle's darling daughter.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你是西雅图的第一名，但那是因为你是西雅图的掌上明珠。

sentences.en: Nobody else will like it.
sentences.zh: 其他人不会喜欢它的。

sentences.en: Then she decided to leave the West Coast completely, go to Boston.
sentences.zh: 然后她决定彻底离开西雅图，去波士顿。

sentences.en: Then when I got to be number one in Boston, the boss was like, if you want to be syndicated, you need to be in mornings or you need to do something like a top 40 countdown.
sentences.zh: 后来当我在波士顿做到第一名时，老板却说，如果你想做联播，你需要做早间节目，或者你需要做类似前40名倒计时这样的节目。

sentences.en: This just won't work.
sentences.zh: 这根本行不通。

sentences.en: These phone calls won't work.
sentences.zh: 这些电话是行不通的。

sentences.en: And she heard this over and over, that the phone calls were a fluke, that they wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 她一次又一次地听到这种说法，说这些电话只是侥幸，它们行不通。

sentences.en: One of them goes, God, can somebody just tell that broad to sit down and shut up and play the damn music?
sentences.zh: 其中一个人说，天哪，能不能谁去告诉那个八婆坐下闭嘴，放该死的音乐？

sentences.en: But she kept at it.
sentences.zh: 但她坚持了下来。

sentences.en: I had moved to Boston.
sentences.zh: 我已经搬到了波士顿。

sentences.en: I had moved to Philly.
sentences.zh: 我已经搬到了费城。

sentences.en: I had moved back to Boston.
sentences.zh: 我又搬回了波士顿。

sentences.en: And now I had two kids.
sentences.zh: 现在我有两个孩子了。

sentences.en: And as her life experiences evolved.
sentences.zh: 随着她生活经历的演变。

sentences.en: Hi, mama.
sentences.zh: 嗨，妈妈。

sentences.en: Hi, sir.
sentences.zh: 嗨，宝贝。

sentences.en: You have a good night's sleep, OK?
sentences.zh: 你要好好睡一觉，好吗？

sentences.en: She brought that onto the show, too.
sentences.zh: 她也把这些带到了节目中。

sentences.en: Can I have a couple of kisses when I come home?
sentences.zh: 我回家时能得到几个吻吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: OK, I'll just sneak them, all right?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我就偷偷亲，好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, you're going to sneak them?
sentences.zh: 哦，你要偷偷亲？

sentences.en: I'll just kiss you real quietly.
sentences.zh: 我会很轻很轻地吻你。

sentences.en: And then one day in 1990.
sentences.zh: 然后是1990年的一天。

sentences.en: The skies of Baghdad have been filled up with the sounds of gunfire here tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚，巴格达的天空充斥着枪声。

sentences.en: The show unexpectedly broadened.
sentences.zh: 节目的内容意外地拓宽了。

sentences.en: The tone of the show changed dramatically the night that Desert Storm happened.
sentences.zh: 沙漠风暴爆发的那天晚上，节目的基调发生了戏剧性的变化。

sentences.en: This conflict started August 2nd, when the dictator of Iraq invaded a small and helpless neighbor, Kuwait.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突始于8月2日，当时伊拉克独裁者入侵了一个弱小无助的邻国——科威特。

sentences.en: For whatever reason, in the midst of this geopolitical event, people turned to her.
sentences.zh: 不管出于什么原因，在这个地缘政治事件中，人们转向了她。

sentences.en: The phone lines into my studio melted down.
sentences.zh: 打进我工作室的电话被打爆了。

sentences.en: People were scared and they were upset and they were afraid for their children, their kids that were in the military.
sentences.zh: 人们感到害怕，感到不安，他们为自己的孩子、为在军队服役的孩子感到担忧。

sentences.en: And what does this mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: And it was terrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: So those things began to change the scope, the flavor of the show from just being about, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这些事情开始改变节目的范围和风格，它不再仅仅是关于，你知道的，

sentences.en: romance and falling in love and getting married and breaking up and to really the human experience.
sentences.zh: 浪漫、坠入爱河、结婚、分手，而是真正关乎人类的体验。

sentences.en: And Delilah says that in her career, there's essentially before that night and after that night.
sentences.zh: 德莱拉说，在她的职业生涯中，基本上以那个夜晚为界分为之前和之后。

sentences.en: Hi, is this Delilah?
sentences.zh: 喂，是德莱拉吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 对，我是。

sentences.en: Who's this?
sentences.zh: 你是哪位？

sentences.en: This is Lerna.
sentences.zh: 我是勒娜。

sentences.en: Three months ago, I called you when my son got in an accident and he was burned.
sentences.zh: 三个月前，我儿子出了事故被烧伤时，我给你打过电话。

sentences.en: Oh, I remember talking to you.
sentences.zh: 哦，我记得跟你谈过。

sentences.en: How is he?
sentences.zh: 他现在怎么样？

sentences.en: He's sitting right here by side me.
sentences.zh: 他正坐在我身边。

sentences.en: Would you like to talk to him?

sentences.en: In a speech on Saturday, Prime Minister Boris Johnson said that the new variation may be 70%
sentences.zh: 英国首相鲍里斯·约翰逊在周六的讲话中表示，新变种的传染性可能比最初的病毒高出

sentences.en: more transmissible than the original and would require major sacrifices during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 百分之七十，并且在节日期间需要做出重大牺牲。

sentences.en: Given the early evidence we have on this new variant of the virus, the potential risk it poses, it is with a very heavy heart.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们掌握的关于这种病毒新变种的早期证据，以及它带来的潜在风险，我怀着极其沉重的心情。

sentences.en: I must tell you, we cannot continue with Christmas as planned.
sentences.zh: 我必须告诉大家，我们无法按原计划过圣诞节了。

sentences.en: Soon after, several neighboring European countries closed their borders to British citizens to avoid importing the new strain of the virus and...
sentences.zh: 此后不久，几个邻近的欧洲国家对英国公民关闭了边境，以避免输入这种病毒的新毒株，并且……

sentences.en: We can finally report what our nation has needed to hear for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我们终于可以报道我们的国家期待已久的好消息了。

sentences.en: More help is on the way.
sentences.zh: 更多的援助正在路上。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, Congress finally reached a deal on a stimulus bill that will create enhanced federal unemployment benefits of $300 per week for up to 11 weeks
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，国会终于就一项刺激法案达成协议，该法案将为失业人员提供每周三百美元的增强型联邦失业补助，最长可达十一周，

sentences.en: and give many Americans $600 in one-time direct payments.
sentences.zh: 并向许多美国人发放六百美元的一次性直接补助。

sentences.en: Those direct payments will go to both adults and children,
sentences.zh: 这些直接补助将同时发给成年人和儿童，

sentences.en: meaning that an eligible family of four would receive $2,400.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一个符合条件的四口之家将获得二千四百美元。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Andy Mills and Bianca Gaver, with help from Leslie Davis.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由安迪·米尔斯和比安卡·加韦尔制作，莱斯利·戴维斯提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Sarah Saracen, Wendy Doerr, and Lisa Tobin, and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由萨拉·萨拉岑、温迪·多尔和丽莎·托宾剪辑，克里斯·伍德负责混音工程。

sentences.en: And that's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
